acf.speaker_position: Senior B2B Marketing Specialist at No Fluff Jobs

blocks.html:
She started her marketing journey 10 years ago, starting in performance marketing, through comprehensive support for omnichannel campaigns, to communication strategy. She will undertake any implementation: from creating a creation to implementing simple codes. She likes to delve into data. Problems inspire her to find new solutions.
She is not a programmer, but IT has always been her way. She participated in many digital projects, also assisting IT with system or data migration. A fan of new solutions and the use of tools to improve teamwork.
